page: Amazon Web Services g7.12xlarge is an x86_64 cloud server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical Intel CPU cores running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, with 1 thread per core and no hyperthreading enabled. The system includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a uniform allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

For graphics and parallel computing tasks, the instance integrates 2 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPUs with a combined total of 64 GB VRAM. Storage is supported locally by a 1900 GB NVMe SSD drive. High-speed data throughput is facilitated by a baseline network bandwidth of 175 Gbps.

The inclusion of dual enterprise Blackwell-class GPUs paired with dedicated compute cores and direct NVMe local storage offers high resource density for accelerator-driven workloads. This bundled hardware profile eliminates external storage overhead for active cache layers, making the g7.12xlarge suitable for graphics-intensive rendering, spatial computing, deep learning inference, and real-time visualization pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services g7.12xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server built on the AWS Nitro system. Powered by a 3.9 GHz Intel x86_64 processor with 48 physical cores and 192.0 GB of RAM, it delivers a consistent 4.0 GB of memory per core without hyperthreading. The server features 2 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPUs providing 64 GB of total VRAM, optimized for graphics-heavy and parallel acceleration workloads. Local storage consists of a bundled 1900 GB NVMe SSD for fast local I/O operations, complemented by a 175 Gbps baseline network interface. The combination of dedicated physical cores, high-bandwidth networking, and dual discrete GPUs delivers high compute and memory efficiency for rendering, machine learning inference, computer vision, and interactive 3D application hosting without network storage bottlenecks.
